decision.observation: The shutter slats again cover the booth window after repeated handle clicks, while the next entrant is still approaching.
decision.hypothesis: A single click on the beige handle will toggle the shutter open; waiting afterward should avoid reversing it during animation.
decision.memory: Do not click the shutter repeatedly during animation. Require a valid passport and Arstotzkan citizenship; after stamping, return the passport directly and confirm it disappears from the desk.
